name: grok
doc: xAI Grok CLI on a subscription. Renewal time is shown by /usage in an interactive session. --no-wait-for-background: an implementer that leaves a dev server or test runner in the background must not turn a finished run into exit 1.

usage.note: `grok usage --json` needs Grok's background service, `grok -p /usage` sends /usage to the model: the probe opens the TUI in a pseudo-terminal, types the local /usage command, reads the Usage limit tab (percent of the plan's credit used, reset, plan name) and kills the TUI. No model call.

steps.wait_for: Resets?:|No usage limit|managed by your team

coordinator_env_doc: variables this CLI sets in the processes it starts: when one is set, the coordinator session runs on this CLI, on the account its account_env names in this process (unset = default home). AUTOPILOT_COORDINATOR=<cli>[/<account>] overrides.
